parsed.rationale: All three types — `MaterialBlendMode`, `PlaybackBlendMode`, and `OverlayBlendMode` — implement `.displayName` at exactly line 41 of their respective files within the same package (`Shared/Wallpaper/Sources/Wallpaper/Core/`), which is strong evidence of a copy-pasted implementation. Because all three are blend-mode variants living in the same SPM package with no restraint markers (`is_test`, `is_mock`, `is_sample_app` are all absent), the idiomatic Swift remedy is to introduce a shared `BlendMode` protocol and provide a single default implementation of `displayName` in a protocol extension, eliminating the per-type repetition. The `_Plant_` prefix on `_Plant_OverlayBlendMode.swift` suggests it may be codegen-managed, but the other two files are not, so the default implementation should live in a hand-authored extension file rather than a generated one.
